messages:
sam: urgent meeting in the kitchen. Biscuit Council convenes at 3pm. BYOB = bring your own biscuit. :cookie:

anya: is this a real council or are you just trying to get out of the weekly all-hands? :eyes:

ben: 100% real. agenda: 1) crumb policy 2) rightful claimant of the last shortbread 3) whether to knight someone "Biscuit Baron".

rachael: i nominate @ben for Biscuit Baron. he defends snacks aggressively. :crossed_swords:

ben: i will accept the honor only if there is a ceremonial tea pour and a sash. also, bylaws?

sam: bylaws = two lines: no dunking in overly aromatic tea, and you must share crumbs with interns.

anya: poll: dunkers? 1 for dunk, 2 for no dunk, 3 for dunk but gently.

sam: 3 (gentle dunk)

ben: 1 (full dunk, scientifically superior)

rachael: 2 (no dunk, biscuits deserve respect)

snacks-bot: Reminder: kitchen supplies restock tomorrow. If the Biscuit Council establishes a ceremonial snack, please add to the supplies request form: https://redwood/internal/snacks (auto). :bell:

anya: follow-up law proposal: a rotating "biscuit protector" to guard the stash during sprint demos. volunteer?

ben: i'll take the first week. will wear a paper crown.

sam: glorious. someone take a photo for the lore channel. this will be recorded in the Company Folklore binder (aka the shared drive folder). future interns will be told myths of the Biscuit Baron. :scroll:

rachael: official step: can we get a tiny plaque? "In crumbs we trust." low budget, high dignity.

sam: appointed plaque writer: @anya. deadline: before the next snack drop.

anya: accepted. will make it tasteful and crumb-free. :wink:
